description:
A data entry error resulted in a duplicate inventory item named 'Aniseed Syrup (Old)' being created and used in transactions. Your goal is to consolidate this into the correct master item 'Aniseed Syrup'.

1. Identify the duplicate item 'Aniseed Syrup (Old)' in the Inventory Items tab.
2. Find all transactions (Sales Invoices, Purchase Invoices) currently linked to the duplicate item.
3. Edit these transactions to use the correct item 'Aniseed Syrup' instead.
4. Once the duplicate item has no remaining quantity or usage, delete it.

Start by navigating to the Inventory Items tab.
